text: Refines D-0473: its hold applies to watchers of repositories with TypeScript or Python projects, which are the ones whose drafts would classify bugs as current with no replay to run. On Air, Go only, has its watcher on main from 2026-11-14 at 4715ac44, with -dashboard-url, because its proposals now outgrow a comment and only a build with #911 can publish them compactly. Its gate is pinned after #857 already. Invariant's own two watchers and ask3d's stay where D-0473 put them until #935 lands.
